title: The Beggar at the Ford
text: An old man sits on the stones of the ford with his hand out, patient as the river. The water runs around him and does not wet him. He has no feet, and when the light comes through the clouds you see that he has no shadow either.

options.label: Give him your bread, and try not to look at where his shadow should be.

outcomes.text: He eats slowly and blesses you in a language older than the kingdom. The words stay warm in your chest for days.
He takes the bread with a laugh that follows you across the water and for a long way beyond.

options.label: Walk past him. Whatever he is, he is no beggar.

outcomes.text: He does not look up. Where the Leader steps past him the water turns cold as a grave; their feet do not warm for the rest of the day.

options.label: Take what he has. He has no feet, and cannot follow.

outcomes.text: He has three coins, each older than any king. You agree among yourselves never to say where they came from.
His three coins come away easily. Something else comes with them, clinging to the hand that took them.
